description: faketerraform/v1 — Simulation leaf that fakes 'run a team's Terraform bundle from S3'. Input is spec.tar_url (an s3:// URL to a *.tar of the team's packaged Terraform); on reconcile it pretends to download + `terraform apply` the bundle and writes deterministic fake outputs to status (an apply_id + an image_tag the apply 'built'). The FIRST half of the demo's second DAG: a downstream fakek8sjob depends on this status.image_tag (a composer ValueFlow), so the Job runs the image the apply produced. Teams apply it DECLARATIVELY via a celbom rule or a stdstarlark policy.

tar_url.description: S3 URL to the team's Terraform bundle (*.tar), e.g. s3://team-bundles/base.tar.

apply_id.description: Deterministic fake `terraform apply` id derived from the bundle.

image_tag.description: The image the apply 'produced' — consumed by a downstream fakek8sjob via a ValueFlow.
